mapper.insert: INSERT INTO members ( member_id, email, password, name, phone_number, gender, date_of_birth, status, role_id, nickname, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{email}, #{password}, #{name}, #{phoneNumber}, #{gender}, #{dateOfBirth}, #{status}, #{roleId}, #{nickname}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE( MAX(CAST(SUBSTRING(member_id, 6) AS UNSIGNED)), 0 ) as maxNumber FROM members WHERE member_id LIKE 'user-%' AND LENGTH(member_id) >= 8 AND SUBSTRING(member_id, 6) REGEXP '^[0-9]+$'

SELECT mem.member_id as memberId, mem.email, mem.name, mem.nickname, mem.phone_number as phoneNumber, CASE WHEN mem.gender = 'M' THEN '남' WHEN mem.gender = 'F' THEN '여' ELSE '기타' END as gender, mem.date_of_birth as dateOfBirth, CASE WHEN mem.status = 'ACTIVE' THEN '활성' WHEN mem.status = 'INACTIVE' THEN '비활성' WHEN mem.status = 'BLOCKED' THEN '정지' WHEN mem.status = 'DELETED' THEN '탈퇴' ELSE '기타' END as status, mem.role_id as roleId, rol.role_name as roleName, mem.created_at as createdAt, mem.updated_at as updatedAt FROM members mem JOIN roles rol ON mem.role_id = rol.role_id ORDER BY mem.created_at DESC

SELECT member_id as memberId, email, password, name, phone_number as phoneNumber, gender, date_of_birth as dateOfBirth, status, role_id as roleId, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt FROM members WHERE member_id = CONCAT('user-', LPAD(#{id}, 3, '0'))

SELECT member_id as memberId, email, password, name, nickname, phone_number as phoneNumber, gender, date_of_birth as dateOfBirth, status, role_id as roleId, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt FROM members WHERE member_id = #{memberId}

SELECT member_id as memberId, email, password, name, nickname, phone_number as phoneNumber, gender, date_of_birth as dateOfBirth, status, role_id as roleId, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt FROM members WHERE email = #{email}

SELECT member_id as memberId, email, password, name, nickname, phone_number as phoneNumber, gender, date_of_birth as dateOfBirth, status, role_id as roleId, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt FROM members WHERE phone_number = #{phoneNumber}
mapper.update: UPDATE members SET email = #{email}, password = #{password}, name = #{name}, nickname = #{nickname}, phone_number = #{phoneNumber}, gender = #{gender}, date_of_birth = #{dateOfBirth}, status = #{status}, role_id = #{roleId}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM members WHERE member_id = CONCAT('user-', LPAD(#{id}, 3, '0'))
